description: activitypub/inbox.rs fetch_actor_inbox() applies ACTOR_FETCH_MAX_BYTES=65536 in two places: (1) rejects up front if Content-Length header exceeds the cap, (2) rejects after buffering if the actual body exceeds the cap. This two-layer guard correctly handles both cooperative servers (Content-Length present) and servers that omit Content-Length. The fallback to {actor_url}/inbox on any failure is the correct Mastodon-compatible behavior. This is a well-executed defense-in-depth pattern.
title: decision: ActivityPub fetch_actor_inbox enforces 64KiB body cap correctly
